title: D-OPSD: Continuous Fine-Tuning for Step-Distilled Diffusion Models
summary: A training paradigm by Alibaba for the continuous fine-tuning of efficient, few-step diffusion models like Z-Image-Turbo. It utilizes on-policy self-distillation to enable style and concept adaptation without losing generation speed or quality.
research_notes: Eliminates the need for external reward models by using the diffusion model's own in-context capabilities to act as its own teacher during training.

evolution.summary: Released by Alibaba's Z-Image team as a more accessible alternative to Reinforcement Learning for customizing high-speed models. It is currently applied to Z-Image-Turbo and experimental versions of the FLUX.2 family.
